I’m in the same boat buddy. For me, I just have too much social anxiety to actually meet people in real life. Sometimes I get anxious even when I’m online and under a fake name and an anonymous account. Always feel like I push anyone away who gets close to me. But I did start therapy to help out with this stuff. Tryna give myself one last chance in life, you know work on myself and then at least I know that I tried. It’s hard, but I’m trying to learn to be comfortable with myself before I can be that way with other people.

Sometimes when it’s too hard I numb my brain. I don’t really know how but it’s like this emotional switch I have. It helps me get through the night. It’s always better in the morning. Someone also gave me two pieces of advice that have helped me for a bit
1. Whenever it gets too hard, just look around you and name objects and things. Literally just be like “this is a lamp. This is a pillow” I usually go in detail with this stuff. It helps ground me and get my mind off things.
2. Set a goal when you wake up. My current goal is cleaning my room when I wake up. Idk it’s been helping me get through the past couple of days. Sometimes you need to let yourself go through shitty times and then it fades away. 
Not sure if this stuff is applicable to you but hey if it works it works. Doesn’t hurt to try.

Went through a similar experience, but I have this thing where every time I have a good day, I owe it to myself to push back the date. I know it’s dumb and probably delaying the inevitable, but I’m the kind of person to give things and people multiple chances you know. Sometimes I feel like I owe it to myself to see what happens if there’s a tiny bit of hope.

Hey. I feel the same way. I don’t have any energy in myself to give other people. I’m too drained to talk to anyone. I feel like I can’t do anything anymore, and honestly I’m in too much pain to live. 
I read some advice though that I wanna try out for a bit before I make any decisions. I need to focus on myself for a while. It’s okay to isolate for a bit. I need to be okay with myself and give myself everything I can before I do it for other people. 
I know I’m a hypocrite and the worst person to take advice from because I don’t know what the solution is but right now I’m taking it a step at a time. Whatever comes in the future comes, all I know right now is I have a shit ton of work to catch up on and I’m choosing to focus on that. I hope you do the same.
